claims.claim: Section 14 of the Severance Pay Law (1963) releases the employer from supplementing severance if ongoing contributions cover the full liability at 8.33% of salary. claims.claim: Tikun 190 (Amendment 190 to the Income Tax Ordinance, 2012) lets pensioners aged 60+ who draw a qualifying pension (kitzbah mezakah) of at least the minimum threshold (approximately 5,306 NIS/month in 2026) deposit funds into a kupat gemel le-kitzbah. Withdrawal as kitzbah is fully tax-exempt; lump-sum withdrawal is taxed at 15% on the real (CPI-adjusted) gains rather than the marginal rate. This is the standard post-60 tax-shelter tool for severance, retirement bonuses, sale of business, and inheritance.

claims.claim: Form 161ג (טופס 161ג) is the notice of retraction from a previously elected retzef pitzuim and/or retzef kitzba, filed with the Tax Authority outside a retirement event with a new employer.

Under the Retirement Age Law 5764-2004 as amended (in force from January 2022) women's retirement age rises from 62 to 65 by DATE OF BIRTH over 11 years: 1960 = 62+4 months through 1969 = 64+9 months, and 65 for women born 1970 or later.
claims.raw_snippet: בהתאם לתיקון חוק גיל פרישה, תשס"ד-2004 החל מ - 1.2022 גיל הפרישה לנשים עולה בהדרגה מגיל 62 לגיל 65. גיל הפרישה לנשים שנולדו מינואר 1960 ואילך יעלה על פני 11 שנים, וזאת בהדרגה, מ - 62 שנים ל - 65 שנים, וייקבע בהתאם לתאריך הלידה של האישה.

claims.claim: For 2026 the kitzbah mezakah ceiling is 9,430 NIS/month and the exemption rate is 57.5%, giving a maximum exempt pension of 5,422 NIS/month.

claims.verified_via: Israel Tax Authority 2026 guide to Form 161ד (official gov.il page)

claims.claim: The exempt capital pool is the kitzbah mezakah ceiling times the total exemption rate times the capital conversion multiplier of 180, which is 976,005 NIS for 2026.

claims.verified_via: Israel Tax Authority 2026 guide to Form 161ד (official gov.il page)

claims.claim: The Tax Authority's 2026 monthly-deductions booklet lists the kitzbah mezakah ceiling at 9,430/month, its exemption ceiling at 5,422/month at 57.5%, and 13,750/year for the severance component.
claims.raw_snippet: תקרת "קיצבה מזכה" 9א(א) 9,430 לחודש; תקרת הפטור ל"קיצבה מזכה" 9א(ב) בשיעור 57.5% 5,422 לחודש; 13,750 לשנה
claims.verified_via: pdftotext of the official ITA 2026 booklet; figures cross-checked against the derivation below because the PDF's bidi layout separates labels from values

claims.claim: 13,750 is confirmed independently as the section 9(7a)(a)(2) per-year exempt severance ceiling: the statutory coefficient is 35% of the kitzbah ceiling times 180, divided by that ceiling times 32. Solving with the ITA's published 1.35 and 9,430 gives 13,752, and 13,750 reproduces the coefficient as 1.3502.
claims.raw_snippet: סכום השווה ל-35% מתקרת הקצבה המזכה כשהוא מוכפל במכפיל ההמרה להון ומחולק בסכום המתקבל מהכפלת הסכום הפטור המרבי לכל שנת עבודה כאמור בסעיף 9(7א)(א)(2) ב-32
claims.verified_via: Income Tax Ordinance section 9a(c)(1) read directly, then solved against the ITA's own published coefficient

claims.claim: The 57.5% figure is the 2026 step of a statutory phase-in, not a permanent rate: section 9a(g) substitutes 57% for 2025, 57.5% for 2026 and 62.5% for 2027, reaching the underlying 67% from 2028.
claims.raw_snippet: לגבי שנת המס 2025 – בכל מקום, במקום "67%" יקראו "57%"; (5) לגבי שנת המס 2026 – בכל מקום, במקום "67%" יקראו "57.5%"; (6) לגבי שנת המס 2027 – בכל מקום, במקום "67%" יקראו "62.5%"
claims.verified_via: Income Tax Ordinance section 9a(g) read directly

claims.claim: Section 9c of the Income Tax Ordinance caps the tax on a foreign-source pension received by a new immigrant or veteran returning resident at the amount that would have been paid in the country paying the pension.
